spec.description: Dashboard for JVM metrics with Spring Boot OTLP metric exporter

spec.title: Heap Memory Utilization
spec.description: How much of the available heap memory is used

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{job=~"$job",jvm_memory_type="heap", instance=~"$instance"}) / on(instance) sum by (instance) (jvm_memory_limit_bytes{job=~"$job",jvm_memory_type="heap", instance=~"$instance"})

spec.title: CPU utilization
spec.description: CPU utilization for the whole system

spec.title: Threads
spec.description: Number of currently executing (also called "live") threads (both daemon and non-daemon)

spec.title: Garbage Collection
spec.description: Percentage of pause time spend for garbage collection pauses

spec.title: Error %
spec.description: Ratio of HTTP server requests that have returned a 5xx error code

spec.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_response_status_code!~"2.."}[5m]))) / on (instance) (sum by (instance)(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])))

spec.title: Rate
spec.description: Request rate of HTTP server requests

spec.title: Duration
spec.description: 95% percentile of HTTP server request duration

spec.title: JVM Overview (Micrometer OTLP)

spec.name: instance
spec.label: Instance
spec.description: The instance of the application, e.g. pod1
